name: Harmony Reppert
headline: Integration Engineer
about: Technology leader experienced in solution architecture, systems integration, and team development. Passionate about designing scalable, efficient solutions and mentoring high-performing teams. Proven track record of leading digital transformation initiatives, ERP migrations, and enterprise platform integrations across eCommerce and SaaS environments.

experiences.description:
· Customizing NetSuite to align with organizational requirements, including form design, PDF templates, Workflow automation, SuiteScript development, and data visualization via Workbooks).
· Developing advanced Saved Searches and custom Reports to support business decision-making and performance tracking.
· Delivering tailored NetSuite training sessions to cross-functional teams, ensuring user adoption and system proficiency.
· Authoring comprehensive documentation, including enhancement summaries, process definitions, and user guides to support training and internal knowledge transfer.
· Designing and implementing integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Celigo, Magento, Shopify, WooCommerce, and ShipStation to streamline operations and improve data consistency.

· Strategic Technology Leadership: Served on the Leadership Team to shape company strategy, define process and policies, and mentor new leaders and the Culture & HR Department. Founded the Technology Department to support 60-70 employees across all functions and align technology with business goals. Led discovery sessions to identify challenges, technical requirements, business goals, and priorities. Performed software selections and scoped custom solutions. Presented tailored demonstrations and facilitated solution training.
· Enterprise Systems & Integrations: Led the company-wide ERP migration from Sage 100 to NetSuite OneWorld, delivering the project on time. Designed and executed advanced customizations, SuiteScripts, Workflows, Reports, and SOPs. Integrated NetSuite with platforms including Versapay, Avalara, Pacejet, SPS Commerce, Celigo, and SuiteCommerce InStore.
· Digital Infrastructure & Process Optimization: Oversaw the implementation and maintenance of tools such as an internal custom AI chatbot, Google Workspace, Asana, Slack, Salsify PIM, AWS, Shopify, and Magento. Improved access to business data through a custom Microsoft SQL Server-based data warehouse, enabling Microsoft Power BI dashboards and reporting. Streamlined internal systems including Google Drive and Asana.
· People Leadership & Culture Building: Grew the department from 2 to 5 employees, developed job descriptions and career paths, led 1:1s and performance reviews, and coached staff across departments. Facilitated Manager Development sessions on key leadership topics including time management, communication, documentation, Asana organization, Drive organization, conflict resolution, and performance reviews to build a high-performing, growth-minded culture.
· Security, Compliance & Support: Guided security awareness initiatives via KnowBe4 campaigns and provided high-level (Tier 3) IT support. Negotiated vendor contracts to reduce costs and align with a departmental budget.

· Technology Strategy & Architecture: Scoped and designed end-to-end solution architecture for eCommerce and system integration projects, leveraging platforms such as NetSuite, Sage 100, Celigo, Salsify, Shopify, Magento, and Zapier. Delivered scalable and cost-effective solutions tailored to client needs.
· Systems Integration & Performance Optimization: Developed custom integrations and reporting tools using MySQL, Google Sheets, and custom-built connectors. Improved Magento database performance through advanced MySQL/MariaDB optimization and reduced deployment downtime from one hour to 15 minutes through automated processes.
· Project & Client Management: Oversaw all aspects of development, DevOps, and project management. Implemented Teamwork project management software with custom webhooks to automate tasks. Managed 20 client accounts (sizes up to $75M in revenue), facilitated weekly stakeholder meetings, and ensured on-time, in-scope delivery. Led discovery sessions with new and existing clients to understand business priorities, technical challenges, and solution goals. Created and negotiated solution proposals. Presented solution demonstrations tailored to client needs.
· Process Improvement & Operational Efficiency: Introduced operational workflows and SOPs that increased throughput by 35%. Developed a modular proposal process that empowered clients to align project scope with budget, enhancing transparency and satisfaction.
· Leadership & Organizational Development: Led the company's rebranding initiative and implemented Google Workspace across the organization. Established onboarding/offboarding processes and fostered a collaborative culture focused on mentorship, work-life balance, and team development.

· Architected and led full-cycle ERP-to-eCommerce integrations between Sage 100 and platforms such as Magento, Shopify, BigCommerce, and PrestaShop, including platform selection, data readiness assessments, custom module development, and client training.
· Managed end-to-end project delivery for multiple clients, overseeing requirements, timelines, resource allocation, and quality assurance, ensuring solutions consistently met business needs and client satisfaction.
· Owned product strategy and technical roadmap for proprietary Sage 100 integration tools, balancing feature enhancements, bug fixes, and release coordination to align with client needs and business goals.
· Mentored team members and promoted a collaborative team culture focused on high-quality deliverables and knowledge sharing.

· Customized Magento applications to align with client-specific business requirements, improving functionality and user experience.
· Upgraded and refactored Magento extensions to support version changes and migrations from Magento Community to Enterprise editions.
· Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement custom integrations between platforms including Fishbowl, Magento, OrderDesk, and ShipStation, enhancing operational efficiency and data flow.

· Led customization and extension of the Magento platform to meet business needs, including integrations with third-party tools, automated invoicing, catalog enhancements, and Magento version upgrades.
· Successfully implemented the first Warehouse Management System (Snapfulfil), designing a custom Magento integration, which streamlined order fulfillment and improved inventory accuracy.
· Optimized inventory integration by building robust stored procedures for seamless product and inventory imports from Retail Pro, ensuring data consistency and availability for Magento.
· Architected and deployed a custom web-based data analytics tool, leveraging Magento data to deliver actionable insights and improve cross-departmental reporting capabilities.
· Provided expert Tier 3 support and developed fraud prevention strategies in collaboration with PayPal and Kount, safeguarding revenue and enhancing customer service operations.

· Architected, developed, and maintained secure, high-performance web applications using PHP and JavaScript, integrating with complex financial systems and diverse databases (MySQL, Oracle, IBM DB2) to manage sensitive HR/financial data for 300+ customers.
· Engineered and implemented custom Magento extensions and multi-vendor solutions, extending core platform functionality for automated invoicing, data reporting, and third-party integrations, enhancing system capabilities.
· Configured and optimized robust server infrastructures (Linux, Windows, Apache, IIS, PHP, MySQL, SMTP, SSH), ensuring scalability and reliability for mission-critical web applications, performing detailed hardware and traffic analysis.
· Drove significant application performance improvements through advanced SQL statement optimization and continuous system monitoring, directly reducing web page load times and enhancing the responsiveness of enterprise-level systems.
· Provided technical leadership to a 4-person team, conducting rigorous design and code reviews, and training new programmers.

· Developed custom web applications using PHP and Java, directly aligning with client needs to enhance competitive positioning and improve customer satisfaction.
· Designed, optimized, and implemented MySQL databases with data normalization techniques, improving efficiency and lowering business operation costs.
